tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 4, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0201", "detail": "Line 4 'Pulpen Gel Hitam (kotak)' is ordered at unit price 52,700, while the invoice bills 54,500."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-001#2.2", "detail": "Unit prices change only by written, signed addendum and never retroactively; no addendum covers this item."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-001#11.1", "detail": "Addendum No. 1 of 14 Aug 2026 changes only the price of Kertas HVS A4 80gsm (to Rp 56,100 from 11 Oct 2026), so it does not authorise the higher pen price."}, {"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0201", "detail": "Billing position for PO-2026-0201: value received with tax 15,410,130 vs invoiced including this invoice 15,418,122; within_received = false, the gap being exactly the 1,800/unit excess on line 4 plus tax."}], "explanation": "The invoice bills line 4 at 54,500 per box against the 52,700 per box agreed on PO-2026-0201, and no contract clause or addendum raises the price of this item, so the excess is an overcharge."}]}
